candidates.source_name: NEN — Národní elektronický nástroj (National Electronic Tool for e-procurement)
candidates.why_relevant: Central Czech e-procurement platform where a large share of state bodies run tenders end-to-end. Detail pages carry zadávací dokumentace, estimated value, CPV, and the awarded supplier. Confirmed to contain banking/payment-relevant procedures, e.g. payment-gateway services for ČTÚ (N006-24-V00022811), a Dynamic Purchasing System for payment gateways for public administration run by Ministry of Interior (N006-20-V00032360), and card-acceptance/terminal rental tenders (N006-24-V00003391).
candidates.access_status: public, free; browsing without login; bulk/structured export unclear
candidates.legal_status: official public register under Act 134/2016 Sb.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword + CPV filtered search on the veřejné zakázky list; harvest detail pages (detail-zakazky/N006-...) on a schedule; also mirror via NIPEZ open data where published. Prefer /en/ mirror only as a cross-check, cs pages are canonical.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball into concrete award detail pages
queries_used: nen.nipez.cz veřejná zakázka "platební systém" banka

candidates.source_name: Věstník veřejných zakázek (VVZ) — Czech public contracts bulletin
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory single point where contracting authorities publish contract notices AND 'Oznámení o výsledku zadávacího řízení' (award notices) under Act 134/2016 Sb. Award forms name the winning supplier and the contract value — the canonical evidence layer for who won which core banking / card / payment system contract.
candidates.access_status: public, free web search form; form IDs are stable per-notice
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Form-based search by CPV and free text; crawl Form03 (award) displays; cross-link to TED for above-threshold notices.
queries_used: vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz Věstník veřejných zakázek oznámení o výsledku zadávacího řízení bankovní systém

candidates.source_name: Registr smluv (ISRS) — Czech contract register
candidates.why_relevant: Under Act 340/2015 Sb. every contract above CZK 50k concluded by a mandatory public body must be published, with the full contract text attached, within 30 days — otherwise it is void. This is the single richest legal-disclosure channel for actual vendor names, contract value, duration and often full SLA/scope PDFs for banking, card and payment systems. Administered by DIA since 2023.
candidates.source_subtype: statutory contract register with full documents
candidates.access_status: public, free; detailed search UI plus open-data dumps in NKOD
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the NKOD open-data dataset of Registr smluv for monthly bulk XML dumps rather than scraping the UI; filter by supplier IČO and by keyword in subject; then pull attached contract PDFs for scope/value extraction.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball to NKOD dataset record
queries_used: registr smluv smlouvy.gov.cz dodavatel "platební brána" smlouva

candidates.source_name: Registr smluv open dataset in NKOD (Národní katalog otevřených dat)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable distribution of the contract register — the practical ingestion path for longitudinal vendor/contract-value tracking without scraping.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve DCAT distributions from the dataset record; schedule monthly dump ingestion into a local store keyed by IČO.
queries_used: data.gov.cz otevřená data Věstník veřejných zakázek dataset zakázky

candidates.source_name: Portál o veřejných zakázkách (portal-vz.cz) — MMR methodology & NIPEZ hub
candidates.why_relevant: Official hub explaining how NIPEZ / VVZ / profily zadavatele / NEN interlock, which forms exist and what must be published where. Essential to design a complete crawl and to know what evidence is legally guaranteed to exist. Also hosts annual state-of-procurement reports and a decisions database.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off methodology read + periodic check of annual reports and metodiky; use to maintain the crawl map.
queries_used: vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz Věstník veřejných zakázek oznámení o výsledku zadávacího řízení bankovní systém

candidates.source_name: E-ZAK ČNB — Czech National Bank contracting-authority profile
candidates.why_relevant: ČNB is the central bank and the single most strategically relevant Czech public buyer of banking/payment IT (CERTIS, cash handling, card acquiring for own operations, core IT). Its profil zadavatele carries below-threshold and small-scale contracts that never reach VVZ. IČO 48136450, VVZ profile ID 342165.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl contract_display_*.html listing pages; diff against previous snapshot; pull award info and link to Registr smluv by IČO for the signed contract PDF.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query 'profil zadavatele Česká národní banka'
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká národní banka veřejné zakázky IT

candidates.source_name: ČNB — Veřejné zakázky (official procurement landing page)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative pointer from ČNB to all channels it uses (E-ZAK profile, Gemin e-marketplace), plus its internal thresholds — tells you which contract sizes will and will not be visible where.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency check for channel changes; treat as routing table.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká národní banka veřejné zakázky IT

candidates.source_name: Gemin — elektronické tržiště (e-marketplace), ČNB profile
candidates.why_relevant: One of the certified Czech e-marketplaces used for small-scale and below-threshold purchases. ČNB explicitly routes procurement here, so it captures the long tail of banking-IT spend (licences, support, integration work) invisible in VVZ.
candidates.access_status: public profile pages; some detail may need login
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the ČNB profile page and marketplace search for banking/payment CPV; snapshot listings.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká národní banka veřejné zakázky IT

candidates.source_name: Tender arena — profil zadavatele platform (Česká pošta, EGAP, Národní rozvojová banka)
candidates.why_relevant: Hosts contracting-authority profiles for several high-value banking/payments-adjacent state bodies: Česká pošta s.p. (profile Z0002718 — postal payment/cash services, Czech POINT, large IT), EGAP (export credit insurer) and Národní rozvojová banka (state development bank, ex-ČMZRB). These are exactly the state-owned financial institutions that buy core/payment systems.
candidates.access_status: public listing of profiles; bidding requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate the profile list, pin the profile IDs for target financial-sector authorities, then poll each profile's contract list.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on state financial institutions + snowball
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká pošta ČSSZ EGAP Česká exportní banka veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Česká pošta, s.p. — Veřejné zakázky
candidates.why_relevant: Czech Post operates postal payment orders, cash services, Czech POINT and (historically) Poštovní spořitelna-linked counters; it is a major buyer of payment/terminal/counter systems. Page routes to its Tender arena profile.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as routing pointer; collect from the linked Tender arena profile and cross-check Registr smluv by Česká pošta IČO.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká pošta ČSSZ EGAP Česká exportní banka veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: EGAP — Veřejné zakázky (Export Guarantee and Insurance Company)
candidates.why_relevant: State export-credit insurer; a financial institution whose core insurance/underwriting and payment IT procurement is legally disclosed. Publishes via Tender arena profile.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Routing pointer to Tender arena profile; also query Registr smluv by EGAP IČO.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká pošta ČSSZ EGAP Česká exportní banka veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Národní rozvojová banka, a.s. — profil zadavatele (Tender arena)
candidates.why_relevant: State development bank (formerly ČMZRB) — a real bank subject to procurement law, therefore its core banking / loan-origination / payment infrastructure purchases are publicly disclosed. Rare and high-value evidence of a Czech bank's vendor stack.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll profile contract list; join to Registr smluv entries by the bank's IČO for signed contracts and annexes.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká pošta ČSSZ EGAP Česká exportní banka veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR — Profil zadavatele
candidates.why_relevant: MF owns state treasury/payment infrastructure (Státní pokladna, IISSP), tax payment channels and centrally coordinated purchasing (společný nákup) for the resort — a major source of payment-systems contracts and of vendor framework agreements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Follow the profile link to its e-tool; monitor 'společný nákup' framework agreements; join to Registr smluv.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká národní banka veřejné zakázky IT
profil zadavatele Česká pošta ČSSZ EGAP Česká exportní banka veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: Hlídač státu — Hlídač veřejných zakázek & Hlídač smluv (+ public API)
candidates.why_relevant: NGO aggregator that normalises Registr smluv, VVZ/procurement, subsidies and ÚOHS decisions into one searchable, API-accessible corpus. Supports field prefixes icoDodavatel:, icoZadavatel:, cpv: — which makes vendor-level and CPV-level longitudinal analysis practical without building your own ETL. Best single entry point for competitor/vendor mapping.
candidates.access_status: free public web; API documented, token typically required by registration
candidates.legal_status: third-party aggregator of open public data; check API terms before bulk use
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register for API access, query /api/v1 endpoints by icoDodavatel and cpv; use as the primary index, then verify hits against smlouvy.gov.cz / VVZ primary records.
queries_used: hlidacstatu.cz API registr smluv veřejné zakázky otevřená data

candidates.source_name: RegistrySmluv.cz — alternative contract-register search front-end
candidates.why_relevant: Independent search interface over the same statutory contract data; useful as a redundancy path and sometimes for better full-text search of contract subjects than the official UI.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use only as fallback/cross-check; always cite the primary smlouvy.gov.cz record.
queries_used: registr smluv smlouvy.gov.cz dodavatel "platební brána" smlouva

candidates.source_name: vhodne-uverejneni.cz — profil zadavatele platform and procurement explainers
candidates.why_relevant: Another multi-tenant profil zadavatele host (e.g. it carries a ČNB profile page under IČO 48136450 and a Česká pošta profile). Also publishes practical explainers on what VVZ vs profil zadavatele vs e-tržiště each contain — useful for coverage design.
candidates.legal_status: commercial certified e-tool hosting statutory profiles
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve authority profiles by IČO (/profil/{ico}); poll target financial-sector authorities.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká národní banka veřejné zakázky IT
vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz ... oznámení o výsledku zadávacího řízení

candidates.source_name: E-ZAKAZKY.CZ — profil zadavatele platform
candidates.why_relevant: Third major commercial e-tool hosting Czech contracting-authority profiles. Needed for full coverage because Czech authorities are split across NEN, E-ZAK instances, Tender arena, Gemin, vhodné uveřejnění and E-ZAKAZKY.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Search across hosted profiles for banking/payment CPV and keywords; snapshot.
queries_used: profil zadavatele Česká pošta ČSSZ EGAP Česká exportní banka veřejné zakázky

candidates.source_name: ÚOHS — Sbírky rozhodnutí (antitrust/procurement-review decisions)
candidates.why_relevant: Procurement-review decisions expose things tender notices hide: which vendors bid and lost, who challenged whom, disputed technical specifications, allegations of vendor lock-in in core banking/IT. ÚOHS even publishes a periodically updated compendium of selected IT-procurement decisions. High-value competitor-intelligence layer.
candidates.access_status: public; also mirrored as an open dataset (16k+ records) in NKOD and on Hlídač státu
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Ingest the NKOD 'Sbírka rozhodnutí ÚOHS' dataset; keyword-filter for banking, karetní, platební, core banking, and for target vendor names.
queries_used: ÚOHS sbírka rozhodnutí veřejné zakázky databáze uohs.cz rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: Portál gov.cz — Registr smluv service page (publication mechanics)
candidates.why_relevant: Explains the publication workflow, metadata schema and legal exemptions — needed to know what is systematically missing (e.g. contracts exempt from disclosure) before drawing coverage conclusions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read; re-check after legislative amendments.
queries_used: registr smluv smlouvy.gov.cz dodavatel "platební brána" smlouva

candidates.source_name: NKOD / data.gov.cz — national open data catalogue (dataset discovery)
candidates.why_relevant: Master index for machine-readable versions of every mandatory public register relevant here (Registr smluv, ÚOHS decisions, and procurement-related datasets), with DCAT distributions and open formal standards. The right place to discover new structured feeds instead of scraping.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic catalogue query for keywords 'smlouvy', 'zakázky', 'rozhodnutí'; auto-register new distributions.
queries_used: data.gov.cz otevřená data Věstník veřejných zakázek dataset zakázky

candidates.source_name: Ministry of Interior DNS for public-administration payment gateways (NEN N006-20-V00032360)
candidates.why_relevant: A live Dynamic Purchasing System means an enumerable, continuously updated list of QUALIFIED payment-gateway suppliers to the Czech state, plus each mini-tender award. Effectively a public competitor register for the CZ public-sector payment-gateway market — one of the highest-value single objects in this cell.
candidates.access_status: public detail page; participant lists may need deeper navigation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the DNS detail page and its child/mini-tender procedures for admitted suppliers and awards over time.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query snowball into a concrete NEN object
queries_used: nen.nipez.cz veřejná zakázka "platební systém" banka

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public procurement profile page was located for Česká exportní banka (ČEB) or for ČSSZ within this run's searches; results returned other entities instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced Česká pošta, EGAP and Národní rozvojová banka profiles but not ČEB/ČSSZ profiles. This is unresolved, not proof of absence — both are almost certainly mandatory contracting authorities and should be resolvable by IČO lookup in VVZ's profile registry.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ČEB is a state bank and ČSSZ runs mass benefit payment flows; both are high-value buyers of payment infrastructure. Missing them would be a real evidence gap.

negative_findings.description: No page was fetched directly in this run; all candidates come from search-result evidence only.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs and IDs are reported as discovered, not as verified-live. Several of these portals (NEN, VVZ, smlouvy.gov.cz) are known to be session/JS-heavy and may return 403 or empty shells to naive fetchers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Liveness and crawlability must be established by the deterministic verification pass before collection design is finalised.

negative_findings.description: Commercial banks (ČSOB, KB, Česká spořitelna, Air Bank, Moneta) are NOT contracting authorities for most of their IT, so their core-banking/card vendor choices do not appear in this cell's sources at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: This cell can only evidence the public/state-owned slice: ČNB, NRB, ČEB/EGAP, Česká pošta, ministries, ČSSZ, municipalities.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-claiming market share from procurement data alone; commercial-bank vendor mapping needs other workstreams (vendor press releases, annual reports, ČNB registers).

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language term set was established for 'core banking system' as used in Czech tender titles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for 'core banking' in cs returned no distinctive local phrasing; Czech tenders appear to use English-in-local ('core banking') or descriptive phrases such as 'bankovní informační systém'. Not confirmed against real notices in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword recall on NEN/VVZ/Registr smluv will be poor until the actual Czech title conventions are harvested from real award notices.

coverage_gaps.description: Contracting-authority profiles not yet pinned for ČEB, ČSSZ, Ministerstvo vnitra, Finanční správa, Celní správa, Státní pokladna Centrum sdílených služeb (SPCSS), and regional/municipal treasuries.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve each by IČO through the VVZ contracting-authority profile registry (each profile has a VVZ profile ID, e.g. ČNB = 342165) and record the hosting e-tool for each.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV code list was fixed for banking/payments scope (e.g. 66-series financial services, 72-series IT services, 30144/30162 cash-register and card equipment, 48-series software packages).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an explicit CPV whitelist and drive all NEN/VVZ/Hlídač queries by cpv: prefix rather than free text, to make recall auditable.

coverage_gaps.description: TED (EU Tenders Electronic Daily) was not covered in this cell, although Czech above-threshold notices are duplicated there in structured, multilingual, bulk-downloadable form.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add TED (ted.europa.eu) with country filter CZ as a complementary structured feed and a cross-check on VVZ completeness; assign to this or an adjacent cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Procurement-quality/analytics projects (e.g. zIndex, Otevřená smlouva/Otevřená data initiatives, EDZ analyses) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up cs search for 'zindex veřejné zakázky hodnocení zadavatelů' and similar to add derived-analytics sources that reveal vendor concentration and lock-in patterns.

coverage_gaps.description: Bulk/API access terms unknown for NEN, VVZ and Tender arena; only Registr smluv (NKOD) and Hlídač státu are confirmed to expose machine-readable paths.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check robots.txt and any documented open-data endpoints for NEN/NIPEZ and VVZ; if absent, plan low-rate HTML crawling and lean on Hlídač státu as the index.

brief: The Czech public-procurement stack is unusually strong evidence terrain for banking and payments vendors: Act 134/2016 forces tender and award publication (VVZ, NEN, and a fragmented set of profily zadavatele hosted on E-ZAK, Tender arena, Gemin, vhodné uveřejnění, E-ZAKAZKY), while Act 340/2015 forces publication of the signed contract itself, above CZK 50k, into Registr smluv — frequently including the full PDF with scope, value and duration. Practical collection should treat Registr smluv (via its NKOD open-data dumps) and Hlídač státu's API as the indexing layer, with NEN/VVZ award notices and individual authority profiles as the primary-evidence layer, and ÚOHS decisions as the layer that reveals losing bidders and lock-in disputes. Concrete high-value objects already identified include the Ministry of Interior's dynamic purchasing system for public-administration payment gateways and ČNB's own E-ZAK profile. The hard boundary of this cell is that commercial banks are not contracting authorities, so it can evidence only the state-owned and public-sector slice of the vendor market.
